# The ICU root collation elements (as the original engine weighs NChar and
# NVarChar keys, `:en_US`) of the characters and contractions tflip builds
# such keys for, but those of characters weighed by formula (ideographs,
# Hangul syllables, unassigned characters). Worked out from the engine's
# keys by tools/ace/seek/nkeys.py, which describes the model. A line per
# string: its code points (joined by "+"), its primaries (each element's,
# joined by "."), its secondary and its tertiary weights, 05 for a
# compressible common one; "-" for none.
